blurb.bm: Ini rumah ibadat yang aktif: berpakaian sopan, bercakap perlahan dan hormati orang yang sedang beribadat.
blurb.en: This is an active place of worship: dress modestly, keep your voice low and respect people at prayer.

why.en: Yes! It was built in 1800 and is called the oldest Chinese temple in the state.

items.en: 1824 · Guan Yin becomes the main deity
2008 · Part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site

intro.bm: Tokong Kuan Yin (Kong Hock Keong) di Jalan Masjid Kapitan Keling ialah tokong Cina tertua di negeri ini.
intro.en: The Goddess of Mercy Temple (Kong Hock Keong) on Pitt Street is the oldest Chinese temple in the state.

bm: Ia dibina pada 1800 dengan kos 4,000 dolar Sepanyol.
Asalnya ia untuk dewi laut Mazu. Selepas diubah suai pada 1824, Kuan Yin menjadi dewi utama.
Dahulu ia menjadi tempat menyelesaikan pertikaian antara masyarakat Hokkien dan Kantonis.
Ia terselamat semasa Pulau Pinang dibom pada Disember 1941.
en: It was built in 1800 at a cost of 4,000 Spanish dollars.
It was first dedicated to the sea goddess Mazu. After a renovation in 1824, Guan Yin became the main deity.
It once settled disputes between the Hokkien and Cantonese communities.
It survived the bombing of Penang in December 1941.

bm: Pintu besar yang dilukis dengan dewa-dewi

fun.bm: Tokong ini dibina mengikut feng shui dan mempunyai tiga perigi.
fun.en: The temple was built by feng shui principles and has three wells.
